svg.title: Assessment questions and review hints
svg.desc: Mangrove seedlings in 0, 10 and 30 parts-per-thousand salt water grow means of 12, 9 and 3 new leaves. Which claim is supported? Answer: In this investigation, leaf production decreased as salinity increased. Shade plots were also watered twice as often as sunny plots, and shaded plants grew taller. What can the study conclude? Review hint: Find every factor that differed between groups.
